WA CHAT EXPORTER - Installation Guide / Panduan Instalasi

=== ENGLISH ===

WINDOWS: Double-click install.bat. Close Chrome if open, press Enter.
MAC: Double-click install.command. Quit Chrome (Cmd+Q), press Enter.

If icon not visible: click puzzle icon in Chrome toolbar, pin WA Chat Exporter.

=== BAHASA INDONESIA ===

WINDOWS: Klik dua kali install.bat. Tutup Chrome jika terbuka, tekan Enter.
MAC: Klik dua kali install.command. Tutup Chrome (Cmd+Q), tekan Enter.

Jika ikon tidak terlihat: klik ikon puzzle di toolbar Chrome, pin WA Chat Exporter.

Version 13.0 - June 2026
